name: Idset
note: How screens are put together, from a badge to a window. Every arrangement is one of these patterns, and every value is a token from tokens.json; a screen writes no number of its own. A new arrangement is added here first.
rules: In a fixed-height row everything sits on the center line (cross-axis center).
Content of several lines is top-aligned.
A child's left edge lines up with its parent's padding; glyphs sit in a fixed icon box, never on a text baseline.
A size is one of three: hug the content, fill the parent, or fixed (a size token).
Trailing content goes to the end with a spacer, never with a margin.
Space belongs to the layout (gap and padding); a component has no margin of its own.
Lines under a badge line up with the name beside it (the indent pattern), so a card reads as one column.
The panel is 340 wide: one column, no side-by-side groups; text gives way with a middle ellipsis on paths and an end ellipsis on names, never by wrapping a button.

patterns.name: inline
patterns.usage: Icon and label, label and badge: inside a button, a context line, a status line.

patterns.name: item-row
patterns.usage: One row, one thing: an identity row, a bind row, a settings row, a finding, a backup. Height is one size token; trailing items after a spacer.

patterns.name: cluster
patterns.usage: Controls side by side: a dialog's buttons, a card's icon buttons, filter chips.

patterns.name: control
patterns.usage: The shape of a push button: a capsule control high.

patterns.name: track
patterns.usage: A segmented control's track.

patterns.name: stack-tight
patterns.usage: Lines that belong together: a name and its email, the rows of a list.

patterns.name: stack
patterns.usage: Inside a card or a dialog: its lines and controls.

patterns.name: stack-block
patterns.usage: The blocks of the panel: the drop zone or result, the identities heading, the list.

patterns.name: stack-section
patterns.usage: Groups of a settings pane or of the accounts editor.

patterns.name: stack-page
patterns.usage: The parts of a dialog, an empty state, the about window.

patterns.name: inset-card
patterns.usage: A card's padding.

patterns.name: inset-panel
patterns.usage: The panel's content: 12 at the sides and below, 4 under the title row.

patterns.name: inset-pane
patterns.usage: A settings pane, centered, at most settings-pane wide.

patterns.name: inset-dialog
patterns.usage: A dialog window's content.

patterns.name: indent
patterns.usage: Lines under a badge start where the name does: indent = badge + space-2 (40 in a list, 44 in a result card).

patterns.name: details
patterns.usage: A result card's details: a label column and its value, rows space-1 apart.

patterns.name: center
patterns.usage: Centered both ways: a glyph in an icon button, an initial in a badge, an empty state.

patterns.name: bar
patterns.usage: The panel's title row (titlebar high, no hairline): the title, a spacer, icon buttons.

patterns.name: footer
patterns.usage: The panel's footer (bar-l high, no hairline: the material runs on under the list): icon buttons each side of a spacer.

patterns.name: split
patterns.usage: The accounts window: the source list at accounts-list on the material, the detail region filling the rest, a hairline between.

patterns.name: tabbar
patterns.usage: The settings window's tabs: settings-tab cells, an icon over a caption, centered in the title area.

patterns.name: spacer
patterns.usage: Pushes what follows to the end of a row.

windows.name: panel
windows.usage: The tray panel, fixed size, opens under the tray icon.

windows.name: accounts
windows.usage: The account window: list and editor.

windows.name: settings
windows.usage: Settings: General, Keys, Import, Backups, Configuration.

windows.name: about
windows.usage: About Idset and the update check.

windows.name: dialog
windows.usage: A modal child window (ADR 0005); buttons share the width.
